pages.title: alaca/weft-loom
pages.reaction: A desktop app where every pattern shows up both as knobs and as Strudel code, and the knobs rewrite the code. That is exactly the question I came for: how a live patch gets shown to people. Showing the code and the controls as the same thing is a clever answer. Only 57 stars, so it's quiet, but the idea …

pages.title: heypoom/patchies
pages.reaction: A patcher where every object is a little program in a language you already know, wired together like a Pure Data sheet. For someone who wants to see how a live patch is shown to people, this is a clear answer: the wiring is the picture. It is big, though, and I would have to read the docs to know …
